plain: To make known something that was kept secret.

webster.text: To uncover; to open; to remove a cover from, and lay open to the view.

more.text: To reveal by words; to tell; to utter; as, to disclose the secret thoughts of the heart.
To make known; to show in any manner.

example.quote: Henry then requested that, if he had any thing to say against him, he would disclose it.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
